lesson_snapshot: lesson_content.json, 80 slides before this visual revision
overall_rule: Illustrate the operation or decision the learner must understand. Use native TikZ for original structural diagrams and retain source attribution for published images. Do not draw a linear maturity hierarchy from generative AI to agents to multi-agent AI.
definition_guardrails: A generative model call yielding content is one use pattern; generative models can also support an agent.
A classical agent need not be an LLM; an LLM agent is the narrower pattern emphasized in these applications.
An agentic system may use one agent and may mix programmed steps, tools and human review. Multiple agents are optional.
Tool, decision policy, runtime and domain application are roles at different levels. Avoid implying that a named platform necessarily uses a particular SDK.
Loops, routers and worker nodes alone do not establish autonomy or correctness.
source_figures: visual_source_manifest.json contains the two unmodified Anthropic figures, full URLs, credit, SHA-256 checks and visual QA.
